title: Replica kit: LFU eviction and last-writer-wins maps
statement:
# Replicated-state kit (`src/`)

The package contains LFU caching, last-writer-wins registers and maps, observed-remove sets, PN counters, and vector clocks. Preserve the APIs in all five modules. The package has independent regressions in each module: LFU ties must evict the least recently used entry; equal-timestamp LWW writes use the greater replica id; OR-Set merges preserve concurrent additions; PN-counter merges take component-wise maxima; and vector-clock dominance checks include keys missing from either clock.

bugs.summary: Equal-frequency eviction chooses the newest entry instead of the oldest entry in the frequency bucket.
Equal-timestamp writes use the reverse of the documented lexicographically greater replica-id tie-break.
Merging one tombstone drops all entries from the other replica, including concurrent additions with different tags.
Counter-state merge uses component-wise minima instead of maxima.
Vector-clock dominance ignores keys that exist only in the second clock.
